text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I'm scared... L-Let's go home 
quickly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san... You've come to the 
"boundary", haven't you...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyaa!? Please forgive meee...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Cafe...! I-I'm sorry, I totally 
thought...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... More importantly, let us leave this 
place. I will take you to the 'outside'...

text_block_list.name: Woman's Voice
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuu... Uuuuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eeeek...! T-That voice just now was...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They'll come closer if you show fear... 
Please stay cheerful... and dance your way 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? But... um... Th-That's a bit much 
for me...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Muster your courage... and stay 
cheerful... stay cheerful. That energy 
will drive "her" away.

text_block_list.name: Woman's Voice
text_block_list.text: Hey... Hey...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
!! L-L-Like this? Am I dancing it 
right...?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, looking good. Let's keep up that 
momentum and try to smile.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, a smile...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufufufu...! Dancing is... so much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotten quite bright. Light is 
shining into the 'boundary'..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-T-That's wonderful to hear~! Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I had a weird dream last night... 
It was so scary...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, my body feels really light today. 
Maybe it's thanks to having the image of 
that dance lingering in my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Cafe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like you haven't brought 
anything back from the other side... What 
a relief."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. Thanks to you... huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way to confirm if it was all 
a dream... But after that incident, Zenno 
Rob Roy's movements became noticeably 
sharper!
